• Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed)
  • the_hunter2012
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Ban Evasion
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
  • I was banned for evading with the account RubberFactory.  If you check I am a long time member of your community (I was on way back when the server started).  My sister's account is RubberFactory and my brothers account is Tricky_Troller.  I can prove this by having us both on and moving at once on the same ip, I only have 2 computers but I might be able to go to the library or something to join with the third.  As you can see that I was not the one evading ban you can see why I should be unbanned.  I have not joined this server for a few weeks or so and when I joined today I found myself randomly banned and I dont even know why my sister was banned.  I hope you unban me after considering this if you have any questions feel free to ask. 
  • Thanks
  • -The_hunter2012
